column3: What color was the flower that Bizarro gave to Lex Luthor?
column18: Bizarro looks like a zombie on the outside but contains a childlike innocence on the inside. He once picked a yellow flower to give Luthor in the comics.

column3: Which of the following characters has been continuously trying to save his beloved wife?
column18: Mr. Freeze loved his wife so much that he froze her using high-tech equipment because she was terminally ill, and has been researching ways to cure her.

column3: What is the team of Superman and Batman called?
column18: They complement each other perfectly in battle and are therefore referred as the "World's Finest.

column3: What is Harley Quinn's term of endearment for the Joker?
column18: Harley Quinn was madly obsessed with the Joker and called him "Pudding" or "Mr. J" affectionately, but the Joker resented these two nicknames.

column3: Who was the first man that Wonder Woman Diana saw?
column18: Captain Steve Trevor is not only the first man Wonder Woman met but also the first to have a romantic relationship with her.

column3: How many children are there in Shazam's foster home?
column18: Shazam lives in a foster home with 5 other children. They are of different ages and ethnicities all living under one roof.

column3: Which award has Lois Lane won?
column18: Lois Lane is a reporter for the Daily Planet and a winner of a Pulitzer Prize in Journalism.

column3: Where did Nightwing get his name?
column18: Nightwing's lineage stems from the Kryptonian mythical god Nightwing, who was a companion to the Flamebird in mythical times.

column3: How high can the Poison effect stack?
column18: In battle, the Poison effect can be stacked to a maximum of 15 times. Each stack deals damage equal to 15% of Atk.

column3: In addition to DOT, what other effect does Poison cause?
column18: In battle, the Poison effect can deal DOT and also decreases the target's healing received.

column3: Which of the following statuses is not a Control Status?
column18: The Slow effect is not a Control Status. A character can still take action after being inflicted by Slow.

column3: Which of the following characters is strong against Superpower Damage?
column18: Captain Cold's skill can protect himself and an ally with the lowest proportion of HP by decreasing Superpower Damage taken.

column3: Which of the following characters is strong against physical damage?
column18: Clayface's Passive Skill grants Physical Reduction, so he can effectively resist physical damage.

column3: Which of the following characters can deal Superpower Damage?
column18: Firestorm can deal respectable Superpower Damage. The other characters mostly deal physical damage.

column3: Which of the following characters can deal physical damage?
column18: Killer Croc can deal high physical damage and inflict Bleed.

column3: How many Turns does the CD of Batman's Advanced Attack have?
column18: Batman's Advanced Attack deals Physical Dmg to an enemy row. The CD is 2 Turns.

column3: How many Ultimate Points does Batman's Ultimate cost?
column18: Batman's Ultimate deals massive damage to a single enemy and costs 3 Ultimate Points.

column3: In battle, how many Energy collected will restore 1 Ultimate Point?
column18: In battle, for every 5 Energy collected, an Ultimate Point is restored, so the characters can cast their Ultimates.

column3: Which of the following characters can deal damage to the enemy's back row and ignore the front row?
column18: Mirror Master's Ultimate attacks each enemy in the back row 4 times, each dealing Superpower Damage.

column3: Bane works best with characters that can heal. Who of the following characters cannot heal?
column18: Poison Ivy's attack will inflict Poison that blocks healing to allies.

column3: A Tank character shines in the front row, taking damage for the team. Which of the following characters is not a Tank character?
column18: Black Manta deals damage to a single enemy target and inflicts Burn. He is a DPS character.

column3: A DPS character works best in the back row, dealing massive damage to the enemies. Which of the following characters is not a DPS character?
column18: Grodd is a Tank character, suitable to be placed in the front row to take damage. He can also inflict several debuffs on the enemy.

column3: A Support character provides various benefits and assists the team. Which of the following characters is not a Support character?
column18: Bane is a Tank character, suitable to be placed in the front row to take damage. He can also inflict Stun on the enemy.

column3: What rank do elite characters need to reach before character fragments can be used as rank up material for epic characters?
column18: Elite characters and rare characters need to reach Rank 3 before character fragments can be used as rank up material.

column3: What rank do legendary characters start at?
column18: All legendary characters start at Rank 5, and they are very powerful.

column3: Which of the following is not one of the three traits?
column18: Character traits include Strength, Agility, and Intellect. These three traits have a triangle relationship where each one is effective against another but ineffective against the third. An effective attack deals 30% extra damage.

column3: Which of the following is not one of the three classes?
column18: Character classes include DPS, Tank, and Support. A DPS can deal massive damage, a Tank can act as a strong shield, while a Support excels at assisting the team.

column3: How many equipment slots does each character have?
column18: Each character has 6 equipment slots. A maximum of 6 pieces of equipment can be equipped.

column3: What is the duration of supply rewards that you can instantly obtain from using Quick Collect?
column18: Quick Collects refresh every day. After using a Quick Collect, you will instantly obtain 120 minutes worth of supply rewards that can be used to upgrade your team.

column3: What is the item that can revive characters in Elseworld?
column18: Adrenaline Shot can be used to revive all team members who were defeated during the exploration in Elseworld.

column3: How many mercenaries can you hire per week from your League members?
column18: Players can hire mercenaries from League members 3 times every week to help them through difficult stages.
